metadata.description: Cross-plugin compilation pattern database for KAIN-to-UE5 pipeline

syntax_fixes.name: Variable Declaration Syntax
syntax_fixes.description: Replace 'var' keyword with 'let' for variable declarations
syntax_fixes.root_cause: KAIN syntax uses 'let' for immutable bindings, not 'var'
syntax_fixes.notes: Most common syntax fix across all plugins

syntax_fixes.name: Boolean Negation Operator
syntax_fixes.description: Replace 'not' operator with '== false' for boolean negation
syntax_fixes.root_cause: KAIN uses '== false' for boolean negation, not 'not' keyword

syntax_fixes.name: Logical Operators
syntax_fixes.description: Replace '&&' with 'and' and '||' with 'or' for logical operations

syntax_fixes.name: For Loop Conversion
syntax_fixes.description: Convert 'for i in start..end' to while loop with explicit counter
syntax_fixes.error_message: Parse error: for loops not yet supported
syntax_fixes.root_cause: KAIN parser doesn't support for..in range syntax yet
syntax_fixes.fix_description: Convert to while loop with explicit initialization, condition, and increment

code_example.after:
let i = 0
while i < chunk_size:
    process(i)
    i = i + 1

backend_changes.description: Add for loop support to parser and codegen

syntax_fixes.notes: Increases verbosity by 5x, high priority for language improvement

syntax_fixes.name: Struct Field Access
syntax_fixes.description: Replace '::' with '.' for struct field access
syntax_fixes.error_message: Type error: '::' is for enum variants, use '.' for struct fields
syntax_fixes.root_cause: Confusion between enum variant access (::) and struct field access (.)
syntax_fixes.notes: Most frequent fix pattern across all plugins

syntax_fixes.name: Struct Literal Elimination
syntax_fixes.description: Replace struct literal syntax with field-by-field assignment
syntax_fixes.error_message: Parse error: struct literals not yet supported
syntax_fixes.root_cause: KAIN parser doesn't support struct literal syntax yet
syntax_fixes.fix_description: Convert 'TypeName { field: val }' to field-by-field assignment

code_example.before: let coord = VoxelCoord { x: 10, y: 20, z: 30 }
code_example.after:
let coord = VoxelCoord()
coord.x = 10
coord.y = 20
coord.z = 30

backend_changes.description: Add struct literal support to parser and codegen

syntax_fixes.notes: Increases verbosity by 4x, high priority for language improvement

syntax_fixes.name: Vector Constructor Syntax
syntax_fixes.description: Replace 'Vec3i { x, y, z }' with 'vec3i(x, y, z)' constructor call
syntax_fixes.error_message: Parse error: struct literals not yet supported
syntax_fixes.root_cause: Vector types use constructor function syntax, not struct literal syntax
syntax_fixes.fix_description: Replace 'Vec3i { x, y, z }' with 'vec3i(x, y, z)'

code_example.before: let pos = Vec3i { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }

syntax_fixes.notes: Related to struct literal issue but has workaround

syntax_fixes.name: Match Arm Syntax
syntax_fixes.description: Replace '=> { body }' with '=>\n    body' for match arms
syntax_fixes.root_cause: KAIN match arms use indented blocks, not braces

syntax_fixes.name: Reserved Keyword Renaming
syntax_fixes.description: Rename parameters/variables named 'state' to avoid reserved keyword
syntax_fixes.error_message: Parse error: 'state' is a reserved keyword
syntax_fixes.root_cause: 'state' is reserved for actor state fields in KAIN
syntax_fixes.fix_description: Rename to context-appropriate name (chunk_state, voxel_state, material_state)
syntax_fixes.notes: Requires context-aware renaming, cannot be fully automated

syntax_fixes.name: Enum Sentinel Variants
syntax_fixes.description: Add 'EnumName_MAX' sentinel variant to all enums
syntax_fixes.error_message: No error, but UE5 convention requires sentinel variant
syntax_fixes.root_cause: UE5 enums often need MAX sentinel for iteration/validation
syntax_fixes.fix_description: Add 'EnumName_MAX' as last variant to each enum
syntax_fixes.notes: UE5 convention, not strictly required but recommended

syntax_fixes.name: Actor Field Declaration
syntax_fixes.description: Remove 'let' keyword from actor fields, use 'state' for state fields
syntax_fixes.error_message: Parse error: unexpected 'let' in actor body
syntax_fixes.root_cause: Actor fields use different syntax than local variables
syntax_fixes.fix_description: Remove 'let' from actor fields, add 'state' for state fields

oracle_fixes.name: RPC Parameter Serialization Validation
oracle_fixes.description: Oracle only checked enum names for RPC parameter serializability, rejecting user-defined structs
oracle_fixes.error_message: Oracle error: RPC parameter type 'MaterialLayer' is not serializable
oracle_fixes.root_cause: Oracle only collected enum names in serializable types list, not struct names
oracle_fixes.fix_description: Modified validate_rpcs() to collect both enum and struct names as serializable types

code_example.before: let serializable_types: HashSet<String> = ast.items.iter().filter_map(|item| match item { Item::Enum(e) => Some(e.name.clone()), _ => None }).collect();
code_example.after: let serializable_types: HashSet<String> = ast.items.iter().filter_map(|item| match item { Item::Enum(e) => Some(e.name.clone()), Item::Struct(s) => Some(s.name.clone()), _ => None }).collect();

backend_changes.description: Added struct name collection to serializable types

oracle_fixes.impact: Materialize and any plugin using structs as RPC parameters
oracle_fixes.notes: Fixed in Phase 1, benefits all future plugins

oracle_fixes.name: Name Collision Detection
oracle_fixes.description: Oracle detects name collisions with engine types but doesn't provide automatic prefixing
oracle_fixes.error_message: Error: Enum 'EBlendMode' shares engine name 'EBlendMode' with enum 'EBlendMode' in Engine/EngineTypes.h
oracle_fixes.root_cause: UE5's UHT requires globally unique type names, plugin types can collide with engine types
oracle_fixes.fix_description: Add plugin-specific prefix suggestion, @engine_safe_name attribute, automatic prefixing in codegen

backend_changes.description: Add automatic plugin-specific prefixing for colliding names

oracle_fixes.impact: Materialize, TemporalBlueprint, Cinema4DMograph, and future plugins

codegen_fixes.name: USF Type Allowlist Synchronization
codegen_fixes.description: Validator had hardcoded type list missing KAIN type aliases (UVec2, UInt, Mat4, etc.)
codegen_fixes.error_message: Shader validation error: Type 'UVec2' is not a valid HLSL type
codegen_fixes.root_cause: Validator and codegen had separate type lists that were out of sync
codegen_fixes.fix_description: Added all KAIN type aliases to validator's allowlist

backend_changes.description: Added KAIN type aliases to validator allowlist

codegen_fixes.impact: Materialize and any plugin using KAIN type aliases in shaders
codegen_fixes.notes: Fixed in Phase 1, should use TYPE_MAPPER for single source of truth

codegen_fixes.name: Constant Buffer Slot Overflow Check
codegen_fixes.description: Validator incorrectly enforced 'binding > 13' limit on scalar parameters
codegen_fixes.error_message: Shader validation error: Constant buffer slot 14 exceeds maximum (13)
codegen_fixes.root_cause: Validator misunderstood @N semantics - @N is ordering index, not register binding
codegen_fixes.fix_description: Removed incorrect slot range check for scalar parameters

code_example.before: if binding > 13 { return Err(format!("Constant buffer slot {} exceeds maximum (13)", binding)); }
code_example.after: // Removed check - scalar params use SHADER_PARAMETER_STRUCT, not individual registers

backend_changes.description: Removed incorrect binding limit check for scalar parameters

codegen_fixes.impact: Materialize and any shader with 14+ scalar parameters

codegen_fixes.name: Struct Field Codegen
codegen_fixes.description: Struct fields not being generated correctly, missing X, Y, Z members
codegen_fixes.error_message: error C2039: 'X': is not a member of 'FVoxelCoord'
codegen_fixes.root_cause: Struct field generation may be skipping fields or not emitting them correctly
codegen_fixes.fix_description: Verify all fields from KAIN struct are emitted in C++ struct with correct capitalization

backend_changes.description: Fix struct field generation to emit all fields correctly

codegen_fixes.impact: VoxelForgePro and any plugin with struct field access

codegen_fixes.name: RPC Parameter Handling
codegen_fixes.description: RPC function signatures don't match between declaration and implementation
codegen_fixes.error_message: error C2660: 'AVoxelPlayer::Server_Mine': function does not take 1 arguments
codegen_fixes.root_cause: RPC parameter codegen may be inconsistent between header and implementation
codegen_fixes.fix_description: Ensure struct parameters use 'const FStructName&' (const reference)

backend_changes.description: Fix RPC parameter codegen for struct parameters

codegen_fixes.impact: VoxelForgePro and any plugin with RPC struct parameters

codegen_fixes.name: Pointer Type Codegen for UE5 Assets
codegen_fixes.description: UAnimSequence* pointer type not being generated correctly
codegen_fixes.error_message: Error: Found 'end of type' when expecting '*'
codegen_fixes.root_cause: UAnimSequence may not be in engine type registry, or pointer suffix not being emitted
codegen_fixes.fix_description: Add UAnimSequence to engine type registry, ensure pointer types emitted with * suffix

backend_changes.description: Add UAnimSequence to engine type registry, fix pointer type emission

codegen_fixes.impact: Cinema4DMograph and any plugin using UE5 asset types

codegen_fixes.name: Component Naming Convention
codegen_fixes.description: Component names not following UE5 convention (U prefix + Component suffix)
codegen_fixes.error_message: Error: Unable to find 'class', 'delegate', 'enum', or 'struct' with name 'UClothingLayerManagerComponent'
codegen_fixes.root_cause: Component naming may have bugs (missing prefix/suffix, double-prefixing)
codegen_fixes.fix_description: Verify component naming applies U prefix and Component suffix correctly

backend_changes.description: Fix component naming to follow UE5 convention

codegen_fixes.impact: MetaFitter and any plugin with components
